name: event-sourced conceptual model
wording: its events: versions of the purpose, each bounded context's description and each concept, each with its reason; its projections: the conceptual model and the history; kept with the project from its latest closing of the books, or empty before the first, earlier periods in version control; its events joining with the change they belong to; never the work
reason: The journal closes its books; it holds the period since the latest close, and version control keeps the closed periods.
